issue.symptom: permission denied for table profiles during message author hydration
issue.cause: NativeMessageService.messageProfiles requested a wildcard profile projection containing restricted columns.
issue.resolution: Use the explicit 42-column projection observed in the current official profile consumer; preserve authenticated requests and authorization errors.
issue.scope_limit: Public anonymous zero-row probes establish a column-grant distinction; no authenticated account behavior or private account data was observed.

official_sources.observation: The api_hetzner flag can rewrite the Supabase REST prefix to https://api.yapper.website/rest/v1/. Authorization failures do not trigger this router's fallback. Both hosts showed the same projection-dependent denial.

limitations: Only two selected scripts were analyzed; relationships through unselected scripts remain unknown.
Static analysis does not establish runtime execution or authenticated production behavior.

probes.authentication: Public anonymous project role; header values intentionally omitted.
probes.privacy: Every profile request included limit=0. No account credentials were used and no profile rows were returned.

profile_behavior: Shared exact official public projection, including banner fields.
Authenticated requests with validated UUIDs, bounded batches and requested, unique, named response identities.
Authorization errors propagate without an endpoint bypass or privileged credentials.
implementation.cancellation: NativeAPI.dataResponse normalizes CancellationError and NSURLErrorCancelled, and preserves other network and HTTP errors.

accompanying_source_changes.behavior: Subscription acknowledgements request a resync only once per replacement connection.
Same-conversation refresh retains visible history until success, merging live changes and deletion tombstones.

regression_cases: Replies, pins and search hydrate authors when wildcard profile reads are denied.
Own and social reads retain public banner fields and account filters.
Foreign, duplicate or unnamed response rows are rejected.
Profile identity batches are bounded and validated.
Authorization errors remain visible without an alternate endpoint.
Swift and URLSession cancellation share the cancellation path; offline failures remain failures.
verification.app_builds: Unsigned device archive and locally signed arm64/x86_64 Simulator Release builds succeeded from the frozen application sources.
verification.release_validation: See native-0.2.2-validation.json for final UI/capture/package/launch outcomes and verification limits; no real-account acceptance claimed.
